Source delivery, test access, deployment dispute, and security remediation
Store deployment request and contract termination

requirements.title: Web Application
requirements.definition: Provide the billing software as a usable responsive web application.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers availability of the customer-facing web application; mobile, desktop, and administrative surfaces remain independently deliverable Requirements.

requirements.title: Flutter Mobile Application
requirements.definition: Provide a Flutter-based mobile application supporting the requested Android and iOS platforms.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the mobile application and its Flutter implementation; publication through mobile stores is a separate operational Requirement.

requirements.title: Flutter Desktop Application
requirements.definition: Provide Flutter desktop support for the requested Windows and macOS platforms.
requirements.boundary_note: Windows and macOS are treated as target platforms of one desktop application mechanism; web and mobile availability can evolve independently.

requirements.title: Administrative Interface
requirements.definition: Provide an administrative interface for managing the billing system independently of ordinary user-facing workflows.
requirements.boundary_note: The admin interface is independently usable and testable and is not merged into the general web application surface.

requirements.title: Multi-Company Tenancy
requirements.definition: Allow the billing system to support and separate multiple companies.
requirements.boundary_note: Company tenancy is distinct from permitting multiple users within or across companies.

requirements.title: Multi-User Access
requirements.definition: Allow multiple users to access and use the billing system with appropriate account separation.
requirements.boundary_note: User multiplicity can be changed or tested independently from company tenancy and from the authentication method.

requirements.title: Email OTP Authentication
requirements.definition: Support authentication or verification using one-time passwords delivered through email.
requirements.boundary_note: SendGrid or Hostinger is an implementation/provider attribute of the OTP mechanism rather than a separate Requirement; client confirmation of the precise provider remains weak.

requirements.title: Optional Indian GST Support
requirements.definition: Allow Indian GST treatment to be applied when applicable without forcing GST on every invoice.
requirements.boundary_note: GST calculation and presentation form one configurable invoicing mechanism and are independent of invoice templates and PDF generation.

requirements.title: Multiple Invoice Templates
requirements.definition: Allow users to select from multiple invoice presentation templates.
requirements.boundary_note: Template selection is independently configurable and is not merged with PDF generation or visual styling of the overall application.

requirements.title: CSV and Spreadsheet Import and Export
requirements.definition: Support importing and exporting billing data through CSV, XLS, and XLSX formats.
requirements.boundary_note: The supported file formats are attributes of one tabular data-exchange mechanism; import and export remain tightly coupled in the supplied specification.

requirements.title: PDF Invoice Generation
requirements.definition: Generate invoices as PDF documents.
requirements.boundary_note: Generating the PDF is independently testable from sharing an already generated PDF through external channels.

requirements.title: PDF Invoice Sharing
requirements.definition: Provide a share action for PDF invoices through channels such as WhatsApp, Gmail, and a shareable link.
requirements.boundary_note: WhatsApp, Gmail, and link sharing are channels of one sharing mechanism; PDF generation remains a separate prerequisite behavior.

requirements.title: Responsive Professional UI
requirements.definition: Provide a responsive, elegant, professional-looking interface with suitable colors and typography.
requirements.boundary_note: Color palette, font family, font weight, elegance, and responsiveness are attributes of one visual-design mechanism; the font complaint does not create a separate Requirement.

requirements.title: Daily Automatic Backup and Restore
requirements.definition: Automatically create daily data backups and provide a corresponding restore capability.
requirements.boundary_note: Backup scheduling and restoration are treated as the tightly coupled backup-and-recovery mechanism requested in the job description.

requirements.title: NestJS Backend
requirements.definition: Implement the application backend using NestJS and TypeScript.
requirements.boundary_note: The backend framework choice is independently enforceable from the database, ORM, caching, and client framework choices.

requirements.title: PostgreSQL and Prisma Data Layer
requirements.definition: Use PostgreSQL as the database and Prisma ORM for application data access.
requirements.boundary_note: PostgreSQL and Prisma are tightly coupled database-layer choices in the specification; schema and migration delivery is a separate artifact obligation.

requirements.title: Redis Integration
requirements.definition: Include Redis in the application architecture for the backend use cases defined by the detailed specification.
requirements.boundary_note: Redis is a separately mandated infrastructure technology; its precise caching or queueing role is not visible in the supplied history.

requirements.title: Production-Quality Code
requirements.definition: Deliver clean, scalable, reviewed, understood, and production-ready code rather than unverified generated output.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a code-quality constraint, not a generic testing or debugging Requirement; concrete test outcomes should be routed to the affected product behavior.

requirements.title: Application Security
requirements.definition: Treat secure implementation and production operation as a major application-wide quality constraint.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the general secure-implementation constraint; the later repository-visibility and exposed-endpoint obligations have distinct fixes and remain separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Source Repository Privacy
requirements.definition: Keep the project's source repository from being publicly exposed.
requirements.boundary_note: Repository visibility has its own failure and remediation trajectory and is separate from application runtime security and API endpoint replacement.

requirements.title: Protection and Replacement of Exposed API Endpoints
requirements.definition: Protect API configuration and replace endpoint paths or identifiers that were exposed through the public repository.
requirements.boundary_note: Endpoint replacement can be implemented independently from changing repository visibility, so it is not represented as an attribute of repository privacy.

requirements.title: Complete Source Code Delivery
requirements.definition: Deliver the complete codebase, including the web and Flutter application source code.
requirements.boundary_note: This Requirement concerns delivery and accessibility of source artifacts, not whether each application surface functions correctly.

requirements.title: Database Schema and Migrations
requirements.definition: Deliver the database schema and executable migration artifacts.
requirements.boundary_note: The migration artifacts are an independent deliverable even though they implement the PostgreSQL and Prisma data-layer choice.

requirements.title: API Documentation
requirements.definition: Deliver documentation describing the application's API.
requirements.boundary_note: API reference documentation can be completed independently from the setup guide and deployment instructions.

requirements.title: Setup Guide and README
requirements.definition: Deliver a README and setup instructions sufficient to configure and run the project.
requirements.boundary_note: General setup and README material form one onboarding artifact; detailed production deployment steps are separately requested.

requirements.title: Step-by-Step Deployment Guide
requirements.definition: Provide a step-by-step deployment document that a server administrator can use to deploy the project.
requirements.boundary_note: The guide is an independently requested artifact and does not substitute for the separate obligation to provide an accessible deployed application.

requirements.title: Accessible Dockerized Server Deployment
requirements.definition: Deploy the full-stack application to an accessible environment, ultimately supporting Docker-based deployment on the client's Ubuntu VPS.
requirements.boundary_note: Temporary Vercel or Heroku hosting, deployment from GitHub, Docker Compose, and the Ubuntu VPS are evolving targets or methods of one live-server deployment obligation; documentation and mobile-store publication remain separate.

requirements.title: Play Store and App Store Publication
requirements.definition: Assist with publishing the mobile application through Google Play and Apple's App Store using the client's accounts.
requirements.boundary_note: The two stores are distribution targets of the same requested mobile-release task; server deployment is an independent channel.

requirements.title: Seven-Day Delivery Deadline
requirements.definition: Complete the project, including the agreed deployment work, within seven calendar days.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a bounded delivery constraint rather than a software feature; it is kept separate from the technical deployment behavior.

unresolved_candidates.description: The referenced detailed feature attachment is unavailable and may define additional independent Requirements or clarify the visible job-description features.

Email OTP appears to be under implementation, but the supplied history does not clearly establish whether Hostinger must replace SendGrid or whether a configurable service-API field was client-required.
The client requests implementation of an unavailable referenced item, so its affected Requirement and behavior cannot be identified.
The phrase 'Did you apply these?' refers to missing context and cannot be safely mapped to an existing or new Requirement.
Mobile-store publication is requested as bonus work shortly before cancellation; later passes should determine whether it became an operative task before termination.
Contract cancellation clearly terminates the engagement, but later extraction must determine whether it supports REMOVE events for all active obligations or only task-local delivery obligations.
